subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “It is a promise that memory will be cared for.”?
options: Looking back can teach people what they gained and what they should not lose.
A strong information system has backups, local knowledge, and voices people trust.
At night, even familiar things can make people ask new questions.
When knowledge burns or vanishes, future people lose questions they might have asked.
